```{r}
# Practical Course on Analysing the Diversity of Microbial Eukaryotes in Environments, October 2026, Urwitałt, Poland
# Małgorzata Chwalińska

library("readxl")
library("writexl")
library("dplyr")
```

Dataset 1
```{r}
# Read tables
tax <- read_excel("test_tax.xlsx")
otu <- read_excel("test_otu.xlsx")

### OTU table ###
# Create a lookup: OTU -> Species from taxonomy table
lookup <- tax %>%
  select(OTU, Species)

# Join Species names into OTU table and replace OTU column
otu_merged <- otu %>%
  left_join(lookup, by = "OTU") %>%   # Add Species column
  select(-OTU) %>%                     # Remove original OTU column
  select(OTU = Species, everything())  # Rename Species to OTU, put it first

# Merge rows with the same Species name (sum the sample columns)
otu_final1 <- otu_merged %>%
  group_by(OTU) %>%
  summarise(across(everything(), sum, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  ungroup()


### Taxonomy table ###
# Replace OTU column with Species values
tax$OTU <- tax$Species

# 2. Remove columns
tax$Pident <- NULL
tax$Length <- NULL

# 3. Remove duplicated rows
tax1 <- tax[!duplicated(tax), ]
```

Dataset 2
```{r}
# Read tables
tax <- read_excel("test_tax2.xlsx")
otu <- read_excel("test_otu2.xlsx")

### OTU table ###
# Create a lookup: OTU -> Species from taxonomy table
lookup <- tax %>%
  select(OTU, Species)

# Join Species names into OTU table and replace OTU column
otu_merged <- otu %>%
  left_join(lookup, by = "OTU") %>%   # Add Species column
  select(-OTU) %>%                     # Remove original OTU column
  select(OTU = Species, everything())  # Rename Species to OTU, put it first

# Merge rows with the same Species name (sum the sample columns)
otu_final2 <- otu_merged %>%
  group_by(OTU) %>%
  summarise(across(everything(), sum, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  ungroup()


### Taxonomy table ###
# Replace OTU column with Species values
tax$OTU <- tax$Species

# 2. Remove columns
tax$Pident <- NULL
tax$Accession <- NULL
tax$rRNA <- NULL
tax$Organellum <- NULL
tax$Length <- NULL

# 3. Remove duplicated rows
tax2 <- tax[!duplicated(tax), ]
```

Combining and saving tables
```{r}
# Combine OTU tables
otu_combined <- otu_final1 %>%
  full_join(otu_final2, by = "OTU") %>%
  # Replace NA with 0 (species absent in one table gets 0 counts)
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~replace_na(., 0)))

# Combine taxonomy
tax_combined <- bind_rows(tax1, tax2) %>%
  distinct()

# Save new tables
write_xlsx(tax_combined, "taxonomy_table_merged.xlsx")
write_xlsx(otu_combined, "otu_table_merged.xlsx")
```
